workstream: OWNER 5556232035 item 5 -- L5 FIDELITY GATE for declaring Phase 1 (L5 replication) operational. Phase order: REPLICATE L5 -> PROVE FIDELITY -> RUN L5 -> MEASURE REALIZED RESULTS -> THEN OPTIMIZE PROFITABILITY.
no_tuning_rule: frozen at commit; any change is a new file with a new freeze time; P&L is never an input to this gate

reference_policy.action: reconstructed L5 sequential policy: relation (open/extend/complete/sell) at state = price band | TTE bucket | behavioral imbalance, conditioned on last_rel and last_size; side by the shared cheaper-touch convention; size and taker share from the fidelity artifact

labels.rule: the label is decided by this gate only; realized P&L never changes it

evidence_sources.historical_holdout: held-out L5 transitions (l5_fidelity_pass.json valid_transitions): model vs L5 on the same states
evidence_sources.realtime_shadow: Gemini shadow rolling_report action_scoring_untouched / research_arm_stochastic (untouched windows only)
evidence_sources.bounded_live: PMUS spring session decision records (decisions[] with state, v2_recommended, acted, refusal, shadow.stochastic.sampled, inventory_before, shadow.l5_target_size, shadow.l5_target_aggressiveness, t_utc)

action_distribution_relation.metric: L1 distance between relation frequencies and the model's expected conditional masses on the same decisions; POLICY view = stochastic draw (sampled), EXECUTED view = acted (HOLD is not an L5 relation and counts as disagreement)
action_distribution_relation.override_allowed: safety refusals (residual_cap, off_distribution_hold, spend_cap, complement_*) are logged per decision; they still count against the EXECUTED view -- an override is visible, not excused

action_distribution_side.metric: share of OPEN decisions whose executed side equals the shared cheaper-touch convention side the historical model was fitted with (live); historical holdout side agreement where L5's side is observable
action_distribution_side.note: the frozen model predicts a relation, never a side; side fidelity is the convention's fidelity

post_fill_complete_gap.metric: percentage-point gap between the COMPLETE frequency after a fill (imbalance >= 1 unit) and L5's expected COMPLETE mass in the same states; sampled and acted views

price_aggressiveness.metric: share of executed orders placed AT the touch of their side (L5 joins the touch; the shell never crosses) and the taker share vs L5's p_taker for the TTE bucket
price_aggressiveness.declared_override: taker disabled by owner rule (maker/post-only only): the taker-share check is REPORTED and marked override:taker_disabled; it does not block the gate while that rule stands

size.metric: median executed size / L5 p50 size for the same state|relation (shadow.l5_target_size), in shares and USD
size.declared_override: $0.05 per-market cap and venue-minimum sizing (rung R1): REPORTED and marked override:size_cap; does not block the gate while the cap stands

timing_cadence.metric: median seconds between consecutive decisions on a market vs the model's next_reevaluation_s (cadence_modal) for the same state; ratio within [0.5, 2.0]
timing_cadence.note: requires t_utc on decision records (added 2026-09-06); earlier records are not scoreable

inventory_trajectory.metric: share of decisions taken with |imbalance| >= 1 behavioral unit vs L5's share of transitions from imbalanced states in the model base; max |imbalance units| observed vs the 3-unit cap
inventory_trajectory.declared_override: residual cap 3 units: the cap itself is an owner safety rule; the share gap is what is scored

maker_taker.metric: maker share of executed orders vs L5's maker share (1 - p_taker) in the same TTE buckets

off_distribution_rate.metric: share of live decisions in states the model never saw (backed off)

verdict_rule: L5 operational only when every dimension without a declared override passes at or above minimum_evidence on live AND shadow evidence, and the declared overrides are each logged; otherwise 'L5 replication in validation' with every failing / unmeasured dimension named
